summary: High-Trend International Group filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of 2,307,700 Class A ordinary shares at $6.50 per share, raising ~$15M gross proceeds. The company acted as issuer. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners served as placement agent on a reasonable best efforts basis, earning a 7% cash fee plus expense reimbursements. The offering closed May 14, 2026. Directors and executives signed 60-day lock-ups, and the company agreed to a 60-day issuance standstill (6 months for variable rate transactions). This is a routine equity shelf takedown for capital raising and does not constitute a special situation.
